name: 用户需求洞察与机会分析
description_zh: 用户需求洞察与产品机会分析技能，适用于新产品开发、营销策划、品类切入前的市场分析。基于三段式提示词框架与四段式洞察到创业落地框架：用户画像识别（避开抓住所有人的陷阱，按复购频次、抗周期性与成瘾性判断核心用户）、情绪动机挖掘、洞察转机会、创业落地。帮你快速理解目标用户、挖掘情绪动机、把洞察转成可落地的产品机会，10 分钟完成传统方法需要数周的分析，产出可直接用于产品设计和营销文案的具体画面。同时覆盖一人公司与小团队的极简创业落地（《小而美》方法论）。
description_en: "User needs insight and product opportunity analysis for new product development, marketing planning and category entry. Use when you need to quickly understand target users, uncover emotional motivations and turn insight into actionable product opportunities. Built on a four-stage framework that goes from insight to venture execution: persona identification that avoids the trap of targeting everyone, emotional motivation mining, opportunity translation, and a lean solo-founder path based on small-and-beautiful principles. Produces concrete, visual insight in about ten minutes that feeds directly into product design and marketing copy, instead of weeks of traditional research."
